title: Make ordinary grep results directly editable
hypothesis: Adding bounded tagged source windows and a snapshot receipt to ordinary grep results lets Sol move from grep directly to edit, eliminating a source read and sometimes a model round without weakening correctness or scope.
falsified_if: Any treatment run fails, treatment performs a focused source read after grep as often as control, mean model calls do not improve, or prompt tokens and latency both regress by more than ten percent.
decision_rule: Adopt only if all treatment runs pass, tagged grep materially reduces post-search source reads, and it improves model calls or latency without a greater than ten percent regression in the other.
